answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can route every newcomer through a staggered quarantine canyon: a new identity earns only locked, non-spendable credit until it independently survives dozens of per-key, beacon-seeded spot-audits spread across many epochs. Because each audit is un-batchable and bound to that identity's sable-stamped long-lived key, one backend cannot amortize the work across masks; every fake must separately grind the full ferrous-hard gauntlet, so an attacker pays per-identity time and compute, never a one-time mint.
